EthreeMaxGain.source: e3: largest computed full-price deviation gain, monotone designs

EthreeErr.source: e3: largest guaranteed error bound e of the computed price (pi_i Delta x summed bracket widths)

EthreeCert.source: e3: largest certificate 2e, twice the guaranteed error bound (the H3a allowance)

EthreeEps.source: e3: smallest allowance 1e-8 pi mu Delta

EthreeViolationsStrict.source: e3: H3a: scored tenant-intervals whose certified gain (gain + certificate) exceeds 1e-8 pi_i mu_i Delta

EthreeMult.source: e3: final modal multiplier of learning tenants, Protected (ours)

EthreePrem.source: e3: premium T(theta) of an honest tenant (mean over tenants and intervals)

EthreePremPct.source: e3: premium as a share of the full-decision payment

EthreeIdentity.source: e3: largest gain-identity residual (same engine; holds by construction)

EthreeIdentityIndep.source: e3: largest gain-identity residual against the independent engine (the H3c rule: within its bound)

EthreeIdentityAbove.source: e3: H3c: rows whose independent-engine residual exceeds its error bound (0 = the identity holds)

EthreeRealGainPct.source: e3: H3d: largest realized-utility gain over constant multipliers

H3a.seed_note: certified for the listed checkpoint seeds of the learned maps only (pre-registration item, STATUS.md §8.3 item 2)
H3a.rule: no scored tenant-interval whose certified gain (computed gain + certificate) exceeds 1e-8 pi_i mu_i Delta (PREREG §6; exact cell enumeration): violations = violations_strict = #(gain + cert > eps_i); violations_max_rule = #(gain > max(cert, eps_i)) is a reported check

H3c_identity.rule: no row whose independent-engine residual exceeds its error bound (resid_indep <= err_bound); the same-engine residual < 1e-9 is reported
